title: Oksankas Gård
teaser: Welcome to a little paradise where everything still grows and thrives naturally

hero.teaser: Welcome to a little paradise where everything still grows and thrives naturally
hero.body_markdown:
**A paradise on earth**

Oksanka`s garden is a tiny handmade paradise on the Earth where you can enjoy peace and quiet in the middle of the forest. It is located in Törnamåla,15 (Tingsryd kommun, Sweden) in the southern part of the country. You can find there a lot of lakes and hiking trails nearby like Stanford.

**Everything here is organic**

We grow and sell organic vegetables, strawberries and flowers. In the garden there are chickens, a dog and cats. Chicken eggs are available to buy for your organic meal. Wonderful, fragrant chemical-free strawberries you can buy throughout the summer and early autumn.

As Oksanka`s garden is in the forest it is possible to order and buy wild blueberries, raspberries and lingonberries in season or some jam all year round.

Complete your vacation with quality and natural ecological food from Oksanka`s garden.
